name: pubmed-search
description: Run a PubMed literature search from a plain-English description of what to look for, then rate every result 1-5 on evidence strength. Returns title, publication date, lead author, journal, volume, page numbers, a clickable PubMed link, and a green-sphere trust weight for each article. Use when the user asks to search PubMed, find studies or papers or trials or literature on a clinical topic, wants a literature search, mentions MeSH terms or PMIDs, asks what is published on a topic, or wants recent papers on a drug, disease, or intervention narrowed by date, age group, or study type. Builds a field-tagged MeSH query rather than a keyword string, shows the query PubMed actually ran so it can be audited, reads every abstract to score it, and flags results whose population or clinical setting does not match what was asked. Every search also publishes a dark-mode web page of the appraised results that leads with what the set actually shows: rates that ought to agree plotted on one shared axis, fielding dates run against publication dates on a timeline, and sample size, response rate, and denominator kept beside every figure.
